question: I asked to cancel my subscription last week but I was charged again. What is your policy?
reply: A charge posted after a valid cancellation request is eligible for a billing review. If a cancellation request was received within the last 30 days but not applied, support may honor the request and apply the earlier cancellation with your explicit confirmation, effective from the original request date. Please let me know whether you would like to open a billing review or apply the earlier cancellation request.
